text_block_list.name: Editorial Staff
text_block_list.text:
"—Then, based on the feedback we've received,
I will prepare the detailed materials!"

text_block_list.name: Editorial Staff
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to get in touch again. Thank you very much for today!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Th-That's incredible!
To have a picture book made
with us as the models...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This is a publisher I've always loved, so...
I was so surprised when they reached out to me!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah.
It's the publisher of a picture book I used to read a lot, so I was really surprised.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: It feels like a dream somehow...
choice_data_list: It's the result of everyone running this far together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Actually, when the offer came to me, that was how it was explained.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid!! Led by your trainee, K.S.Miracle,
the recent boom in the sprint division is truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Until now, there were evaluations claiming it drew
less attention compared to the medium and long-distance routes, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It's an improvement!! Many Umamusume fans
are now paying close attention to sprint races as well!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"This is—our chance!!
Truth is, numerous media outlets have reached out
asking to feature them as the main story!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
By all means, commission them!! Cooperate as much as you can,
and let the whole world know
the sheer brilliance of sprint Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even though all I've done
is run as desperately as I could the whole time—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"If I was able to contribute like that,
then I'm really happy."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! It's awesome that the hype is totally off the charts!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Things might really start changing
from here on out, huh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"To make the world of speed look even more
irresistibly attractive...
maybe we could add more GⅠ races or something!?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!!
That is truly magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If that happens!!
Let's face off there too,
Miracle-san!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah.
...Just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after wrapping up the meeting
for the picture book project, we returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?!
Aren't there still a ton of requests left?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Games~ manga~ and even a stage play?
Whoa! Meeting overload, big time~!
choice_data_list: You can leave things to us to some extent, alright?
You can leave things to us to some extent, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
But...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to do my best and cooperate as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: If there's anything... that even I can leave behind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Not just to those who helped me,
but to pass it on to someone in the future too—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"If it can entertain someone or give them
even a little bit of courage, that is."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because I think that's a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (What is that? Someone's... gaze?)
—Yes, the traces left behind are important, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Picture books, games, manga, stage plays.
And of course, don't forget the plushies.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So that they'll keep it.
So that they'll remember.
It's very, very important.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Are you... Chan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle-san.
Making an appearance even in the corner of your story:
it's Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Guess what, guess what!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You're happy, aren't you? Right now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right!
